hunks.baseline: The moment they saw the streak of light hurtling across the open space, the three thousand rebels charging as one instinctively understood.
hunks.sol: The moment they saw the streak of light hurtling toward them, the three thousand rebels charging as one instinctively understood.

hunks.baseline: The only path they had thought could save them was where unavoidable death awaited.
hunks.sol: Unavoidable death awaited them on the only path they had thought could save them.

hunks.baseline: Someone’s scream was swallowed by the deafening roar. Amid the dust cloud that billowed up with the explosion, headless corpses and men and horses torn limb from limb shot into the air, spraying fountains of blood.
hunks.sol: Someone’s scream vanished beneath the roar. Headless corpses and men and horses with their limbs torn away sprayed blood amid the dust billowing up from the explosion.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t stop! Stop, and you’re dead!”
hunks.sol: “Don’t stop! If you stop, you die!”

hunks.baseline: Overcome by fear and confusion, the rebels forced strength into their trembling legs at the direction of the command still coming from their surviving leaders.
hunks.sol: Overcome by fear and confusion, the rebels forced strength into their trembling legs at the orders of their surviving leaders.

hunks.baseline: The moment they climbed onto the back of a rampaging tiger, their fate had been sealed.
hunks.sol: They had climbed onto the back of a rampaging tiger. Their fate was already sealed.

hunks.baseline: With bloodshot eyes and faces gone white as paper, the surviving rebels screamed in desperation and pressed forward.
hunks.sol: Bloodshot eyes wide in faces white as paper, the surviving rebels screamed in desperation and pressed forward.

hunks.baseline: Praying that the Force arrows that seemed liable to come flying from anywhere, at any moment, would spare them.
hunks.sol: Praying that the Force arrows liable to come flying from anywhere at any moment would spare them, at least.

hunks.baseline: And as they continued their charge, an earnest plea circling endlessly between clenched teeth, a dazzling streak of light suddenly swept across their path.
hunks.sol: They charged on with that desperate plea running endlessly through their clenched teeth. Then a dazzling streak of light appeared before them and blocked their path.

hunks.baseline: No—it swept them away.
hunks.sol: No. It swept them away.

hunks.baseline: The earth shook. The cloud of dust rising into the air turned red as it soaked up blood.
hunks.sol: The earth shook. Rising dust soaked up blood and turned red.

hunks.baseline: Yet the gaze of the person watching that horrific scene—and the hand that kept drawing the bowstring—remained terrifyingly calm.
hunks.sol: Yet the gaze watching that horrific scene—and the hand that kept drawing the bowstring—remained terrifyingly calm.

hunks.baseline: The great bow shuddered. The string and arrow, glowing brilliantly with their owner’s internal energy, unleashed a speed and force no other archer could imitate.
hunks.sol: The great bow shuddered. Its string and arrow, shining with their owner’s internal energy, unleashed speed and force no other archer could match.

hunks.baseline: With another howling gale of light, the death already in store—and the screams that came with it—swept over the enemy. Every time an arrow made of Force flew, dozens of lives went out like candles in the wind.
hunks.sol: Another gale of light swept over the enemy, bringing the death—and the screams—that awaited them. Each arrow made of Force snuffed out dozens of lives like candles in the wind.

hunks.baseline: The closer they came, the higher the pile of corpses grew. The rebels at the front had changed several times over by now, and the men charging forward were howling like madmen.
hunks.sol: The closer they came, the more corpses piled up. The men at the front had been replaced several times over, and those charging now howled like madmen.

hunks.baseline: The only path left to them—and the road to their graves.
hunks.sol: Toward their only way out, which was also where they would die.

hunks.baseline: They pressed on, pawns on a vast game board, until they faced the brilliant light that would be the last thing they ever saw.
hunks.sol: They pressed on as pawns on a vast game board until they met the dazzling light that would be the last thing they ever saw.

hunks.baseline: How many had died by the time the four hundred paces between them had been cut in half?
hunks.sol: How many had died by the time they covered half the four hundred paces?

hunks.baseline: And how many more would die before they covered the remaining two hundred?
hunks.sol: How many more would die crossing the two hundred that remained?

hunks.baseline: No one could answer the question that suddenly crossed their minds.
hunks.sol: No one could answer the question that suddenly occurred to them.

hunks.baseline: Not those collapsing as they felt the life draining out of them. Not those who had to leave their fallen comrades behind and keep going.
hunks.sol: Not those collapsing as they felt the life drain away. Not those forced to leave their fallen comrades behind and keep going.

hunks.baseline: Not even the leaders, who kept shouting for the charge while sending their own men ahead of them.
hunks.sol: Not even the leaders, who sent their men ahead while shouting for the charge.

hunks.baseline: The cry cut off at the same time as a sharp crack through the air.
hunks.sol: A sharp crack cut off the shout.

hunks.baseline: In the blink of an eye, the commander’s body shot off his saddle and slammed into a pool of blood.
hunks.sol: In the blink of an eye, the commander flew from his saddle and landed in a pool of blood.

hunks.baseline: No one heard the rest of what he said, but looking at the General of the Swift Cavalry lying motionless in the blood, no one could help thinking of death.
hunks.sol: No one heard the rest, but no one looking at the General of the Swift Cavalry lying motionless in the blood could doubt that he was dead.

hunks.baseline: There was no question. He was dead.
The powerful military commander, who had held control over the army for many years, died just like that.
hunks.sol: The powerful commander who had held military authority for so many years had died just like that.

hunks.baseline: So suddenly and miserably, leaving behind one question.
hunks.sol: Suddenly, miserably, and leaving one question behind.

hunks.baseline: The leaders nearby were momentarily bewildered.
That terrifying streak of light, too powerful to seem like an arrow, had been nowhere to be seen a moment ago.
hunks.sol: The leaders nearby were bewildered. The streak of light, far too powerful to seem like an arrow, had been nowhere in sight a moment ago.

hunks.baseline: Just as they turned their heads to look for the unseen enemy, a low voice slipped into their ears.
hunks.sol: As they turned to look for the unseen attacker, a low voice reached their ears.

hunks.baseline: “There’s something this old man’s curious about. What do you call the bastards who started this goddamn mess?”
hunks.sol: “There’s something this old man wants to know. What do you call the bastards who started this goddamn mess?”

hunks.baseline: “In four-character idiom? Fucking dog-shitheads.”
hunks.sol: “In a four-character idiom? Fucking dog-shitheads.”

hunks.baseline: “Fucking dog-shitheads, is it? That does roll right off the tongue.”
hunks.sol: “Fucking dog-shitheads, is it? That rolls right off the tongue.”

hunks.baseline: The leaders, frozen like statues, slowly raised their heads.
hunks.sol: The leaders, frozen like statues, slowly looked up.

hunks.baseline: And there they were—two people standing tall in midair above them.
hunks.sol: Two people stood in midair above their heads.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, an ominous feeling came over them.
Maybe what they were seeing and hearing now would be the last thing in their lives.
hunks.sol: A dreadful thought came to them: perhaps the sight before them and those voices would be the last things they ever saw and heard.

hunks.baseline: Then why was their consciousness growing hazy?
There had been two people standing over them. Where had one of them gone?
hunks.sol: Then why were their minds growing hazy? There had been two people standing above them. Where had one gone?

hunks.baseline: “Y-you fucking…”
hunks.sol: “You fucking…”

hunks.baseline: A voice squeezed out between someone’s lips.
hunks.sol: Someone forced the words past his lips.

hunks.baseline: Deep inside their bodies, death awoke late and stretched.
hunks.sol: Deep within their bodies, death woke late and stretched. Faint red lines appeared where a spearhead had passed too quickly to see.

hunks.baseline: The faint red lines left by a spearhead that had flashed past too fast to see appeared across them.
Blood, welling in soft beads, burst out like an explosion. Heads, arms, legs, bone, and flesh—defying their owners’ will—came apart and slid away.
hunks.sol: Blood welled in small beads, then burst out. Heads, arms, and legs separated; bone and flesh came apart and slid away, defying their owners’ will.

hunks.baseline: The young man with the spear, not a drop of blood on it, stood beneath the falling bodies as they collapsed behind him.
hunks.sol: The collapsing bodies fell behind the young man holding a spear untouched by blood—and poured down over his head.

hunks.baseline: The young man, drenched by the red rain pouring from the dark sky, was Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: The young man standing beneath that red rain in the dark was Jin Taekyung. He finally gave them his answer.

hunks.baseline: He finally gave them his answer.
Those who had witnessed the horrific, unbelievable sight before their eyes were struck with shock—and despair, as they realized it was all over.
hunks.sol: Those who witnessed the horrific sight were struck first by shock, then by despair as they realized it was over.

hunks.baseline: Every one of them wore splendid clothes. They were powerful figures whose families had pledged loyalty to Dark Heaven and the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord for generations. They had crossed a river they could never return from.
hunks.sol: Every one of them wore splendid clothes. They were powerful figures who had pledged enough loyalty to Dark Heaven and the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord to secure their descendants’ futures. They had crossed a river they could never cross back.

hunks.baseline: Surrounded by hundreds of guards, Jin Taekyung stood with a calm expression, his spearhead hanging low. Jeok Cheongang still stood tall in the air.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung stood with his spearhead lowered and a calm expression, despite the hundreds of guards surrounding them. Jeok Cheongang still stood in the air.

hunks.baseline: Only then did they understand that their ominous premonition had come true.
hunks.sol: Only then did the onlookers understand that their dreadful premonition had come true.

hunks.baseline: This grand rebellion—and the wealth and glory they had enjoyed for so many years—was finished.
hunks.sol: This vast rebellion was finished. So were the wealth and glory they had enjoyed for so long.

hunks.baseline: Their only consolation was that instead of suffering through brutal torture before being torn limb from limb by carts, they might be granted a quick death by that martial-world ruffian.
hunks.sol: Their only consolation was that, instead of enduring brutal torture before being torn limb from limb by carts, they might receive a quick death from that martial-world ruffian.

hunks.baseline: Until Jeok Cheongang spoke.
hunks.sol: Then Jeok Cheongang spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Leave the ones who look like the top dogs alive. I don’t know if they’re a gold mine or a spent mine, but who knows what we’ll find if we dig? We should at least try a few swings of the pickaxe.”
hunks.sol: “Leave the ones who look like the top dogs alive. I don’t know if they’re gold mines or spent ones, but we won’t know what’s in there unless we dig. Might as well take a few swings with the pickaxe.”

hunks.baseline: It took no more than an instant for the shock and resignation in their eyes to turn into fear. At the end of that brief moment, ten sharp cracks through the air were waiting for them, unleashed by Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: Their shock and resignation turned to fear in an instant. Before that instant was over, Jin Taekyung sent ten sharp cracks through the air toward them.

hunks.baseline: They weren’t given time to take out the poison pills they had kept hidden, just in case—or even a moment to draw the daggers at their waists and slash their own throats.
hunks.sol: They had no time to reach for the poison pills they kept hidden in case of disaster, or even to draw the daggers at their waists and slit their own throats.

hunks.baseline: Finger Qi racing through the air in an instant, stiffening their entire bodies. The world slowly tilting as deep despair weighed down on their minds and bodies.
hunks.sol: Finger Qi crossing the distance in an instant and stiffening their entire bodies. The world slowly tilting as despair weighed down on their minds and bodies.

hunks.baseline: They fell like waterlogged logs. In their eyes, golden flags were already fluttering all around them.

hunks.baseline: Above the writhing dragons, countless arrowheads rained down, painting over the dark sky.
hunks.sol: They fell like waterlogged logs. Golden flags fluttering on every side filled their vision. Above the dragons writhing on the flags, countless arrowheads rained down across the dark sky.

hunks.baseline: A steel rain poured from a thousand repeating-crossbow soldiers, covering the remaining rebels.
hunks.sol: A thousand repeating crossbowmen poured steel over the remaining rebels.

hunks.baseline: The sounds of flesh being pierced announced the end of the blood-soaked banquet. Screams of pain joined them, mingling with the powerful, unceasing beat of drums.
hunks.sol: The sounds of arrows piercing flesh announced the end of the blood-soaked banquet. Screams of pain mingled with the strong, unceasing beat of drums.

hunks.baseline: Rich and sticky as blood.
hunks.sol: Thick and sticky as blood.

hunks.baseline: That was how long it took for all three thousand rebels to be wiped out.
hunks.sol: That was how long it took to crush all three thousand rebels.

hunks.baseline: Along with a rain of arrows, the Imperial Army swept into the grand banquet hall with enough force to put an end to this long, horrific feast.
hunks.sol: The Imperial Army swept into the grand banquet hall beneath a rain of arrows, bringing more than enough force to put an end to the long, horrific feast.

hunks.baseline: A powerful voice charged with internal energy rang out over and over.
hunks.sol: Shouts charged with powerful internal energy rang out one after another.

hunks.baseline: The twin military officers, urging them to surrender with identical voices and intonations, as though one person were speaking, seemed to extinguish the surviving rebels’ last hope.
hunks.sol: The twin officers urging them to surrender sounded so alike in voice and tone that they could have been one man. At the sight of them, the surviving rebels seemed to lose their last hope.

hunks.baseline: They loosened the joints of their bloodstained armor and dropped their cracked and broken weapons as if throwing them away.
hunks.sol: They unfastened their bloodstained armor and let their cracked and broken weapons fall.

hunks.baseline: No one knew who had begun the wave of surrender, but it soon swelled into a tide that swept through the grand banquet hall.
hunks.sol: No one knew who surrendered first, but the wave soon became a tide sweeping through the grand banquet hall.

hunks.baseline: Eyes and faces that looked as if their souls had left them.
hunks.sol: Their eyes were vacant, their faces empty.

hunks.baseline: Some clutched their missing arm and begged for their lives. Others made an irreversible choice at the edge of a cliff, unable to take another step back.
hunks.sol: Some clutched the places where their arms had been and begged for their lives. Others, backed to a cliff’s edge with nowhere left to retreat, made a choice they could never take back.

hunks.baseline: The nameless rebel crumpled without strength. Despair that everything was over mingled in his face with the faint peace he had found in escaping this hell.
hunks.sol: The nameless rebel crumpled. His face held the despair of knowing it was over, and a trace of the peace he had found in escaping this hell.

hunks.baseline: At the faint words Jeok Cheongang murmured as if to himself, I forced myself to nod calmly.
hunks.sol: At Jeok Cheongang’s faint murmur, I forced myself to nod calmly.

hunks.baseline: This great battle, which had swallowed countless lives in plain sight and out of it, had finally come to an end.
hunks.sol: The vast battle that had swallowed countless lives, both in plain sight and out of it, had finally ended.

hunks.baseline: The dead had gone somewhere far away, never to return. But the monster who was neither dead nor alive still remained here.
hunks.sol: The dead had gone somewhere far away, never to return. The monster who was neither dead nor alive remained here.

hunks.baseline: And there was still the matter of dealing with the living.
hunks.sol: And we still had to deal with the living.

hunks.baseline: Someone’s footsteps sank into a pool of blood.
hunks.sol: A footstep landed in a pool of blood.

hunks.baseline: Each light, graceful step left a sticky imprint in the blood—an unpleasant contrast to her delicate gait. I watched her approach, my gaze cold and steady.
hunks.sol: I watched her approach, my gaze cold and steady. Each light, graceful step left a sticky imprint of blood behind.

hunks.baseline: The woman whose every detail had been shrouded in mystery.
hunks.sol: The woman who had kept everything about herself hidden.

hunks.baseline: At our first meeting, she had pretended to be the Emperor’s loyal servant. At our second, she had put on the mask of Dark Heaven. Only at our third meeting had she finally revealed herself.
hunks.sol: At our first meeting, she had pretended to be the Emperor’s loyal servant. At our second, she had worn the mask of Dark Heaven. Only at our third had she finally revealed herself.

hunks.baseline: She was coming toward me.
hunks.sol: Now she was coming toward me.

hunks.baseline: With the catlike steps that suited her name, So Gyo, she crossed the ground scattered with countless corpses—people who wouldn’t have had to die if she had revealed her identity a little sooner.
hunks.sol: With catlike steps that suited the name So Gyo, she crossed ground strewn with countless bodies. People who might still be alive if she had revealed her identity a little sooner.

hunks.baseline: Blade-sharp qi rose from every part of my body. The Bow Saint stopped a few steps away and looked at me in silence, then suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: Blade-sharp qi rose throughout my body. The Bow Saint stopped a few steps away and studied me in silence. Then she spoke.

hunks.baseline: I hesitated, unable to understand the meaning behind her words. A low voice sounded in my ear.
hunks.sol: I hesitated, unable to make sense of her words. Her low voice sounded in my ear.
